title: RSNA 2026 GPT-5.6 Luna Weak Labels
description: Private report-derived weak supervision for the RSNA Knee Abnormality Detection competition. Contains soft probabilities, independent confidence weights, and report-level masks. Use is restricted to the competition workflow and its rules.

resources.description: Calibrated weak supervision for 4,407 studies with Effusion-based Synovitis completion, 12 confidence weights, and one report-level mask.
